title: draba verna var. decipiens
intro: Draba verna var. decipiens, commonly known as False Whitlow Grass, is a plant species belonging to the family Brassicaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma due to its expectorant properties. The plant's bioactive constituents include isothiocyanates, which exhibit therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. Additionally, False Whitlow Grass has been found to possess anti-cancer and immunomodulatory properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
